title: Shadownet CSR JWT payload
description: Payload of a shadownet-csr+jwt. Defined in rfcs/0001-shadownet.md §6.5. The JWS header MUST be { alg: 'EdDSA', typ: 'shadownet-csr+jwt' } and is signed by the Subject's signing key.

iss.description: Identifier of the Subject requesting attestation — a Shadowname or a multibase Ed25519 public key.

aud.description: Issuer being asked — a domain or a multibase Ed25519 public key.

exp.description: Expiry, Unix seconds. RECOMMENDED short-lived (≤ 600 seconds, 10 minutes).

org.description: Disambiguates which organization the affiliation is being requested for — a domain or a multibase Ed25519 public key.
